correctness.rationale: Any group endomorphism is prime-field-linear in BCH coordinates and must satisfy T(det(v,w))=det(Av,Aw). Under idempotence, T nonzero implies ker A=0 and then (A,T,B)=(I,I,0); T=0 forces an isotropic image in a unique field line, with A a projection and B factoring through A. Distinct field lines, Gaussian subspaces, complements, and linear graph maps yield the exact rank counts; the finite defect product has a summable Gaussian tail and gives the stated limit. Direct independent group multiplication tests and small-field enumeration passed. Characteristic 2 and higher-dimensional groups are not asserted.

value.rationale: The question which subgroups arise as retracts of a natural nilpotent group is structural, not an arbitrary slicing. The result completely classifies those subgroups, proves a no-proper-normal-retract boundary, and counts both subgroup and splitting maps in all permitted ranks. The limit law reveals genuinely nontrivial near-maximal-rank fluctuations for extension-degree growth. The case e>=2 is motivated by the prior paper explicitly identifying extension-field Heisenberg groups as a further study direction.
